met_analysis:
The Depression (Remnant of Severe Cyclonic Storm “Murasu”) over east Telangana & adjoining Coastal Andhra Pradesh moved slowly, nearly northwards with a speed of 6 kmph during past 06 hours, and lies centered at 0830 hours IST of today, the 04th November, 2026, over the same region near Latitude 17.2°N and Longitude 80.1°E, about 10 km southwest of Khammam (Telangana), 50 km north-northwest of Nandigama (Andhra Pradesh), 90 km east-northeast of Nalgonda (Telangana), 90 km northwest of Vijayawada (Andhra Pradesh), and 100 km west-southwest of Bhadrachalam (Telangana). Continuing to move nearly northwards, it is very likely to weaken further into a Well Marked Low Pressure area during next 06 hours.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over north Haryana & neighbourhood persists and now seen between 1.5 & 3.1 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over south Assam & adjoining Bangladesh at 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Konkan & Goa & neighbourhood persists and now seen at 1.5 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over South Tamil Nadu & neighbourhood at 0.9 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Lakshadweep & neighbourhood extending upto 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
A fresh Western Disturbance as a trough in middle tropospheric westerlies with its axis at 5.8 km above mean sea level runs roughly along Long. 65°E to the north of Lat. 30°N.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Saurashtra & Kutch & neighbourhood at 3.1 km above mean sea level has become less marked.
